SECTION 11 21 00 — SUBMERSIBLE PUMPS
1. GENERAL
1.1 Scope. This section covers the RAS pumps P-101A/B.
2. PRODUCTS
2.1 Motors shall be rated IP68 for continuous submergence to 20 m.
2.2 The impeller shall be duplex stainless steel ASTM A890 Grade 4A.
3. SUBMITTALS
3.1 The Contractor shall submit pump curves, motor data and the NPSH calculation for approval.
4. TESTING
4.1 Each pump shall be performance tested at the factory to ISO 9906 Grade 2B.
